about: Public detector and fingerprint pages for setup/stealthtest.mjs (V2_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN §6.6). Each page is opened in the launched engine, given a humanized scroll, pointer moves and one click on a harmless spot, then screenshotted; `extractor` names the function in stealthtest.mjs that reads its verdict. These pages change without notice: an extractor that finds none of its fields is a WARN (fix the extractor), a detected verdict is a FAIL. `click` is a point in CSS pixels chosen on an empty part of the page (x/y may be fractions of the viewport). `settleMs` is how long the page needs to finish its own tests before anyone touches it; `afterMs` is the wait after the interaction.
